# Axiom01 — Full Machine-Readable Specification

## 1. Core Architecture & Mathematical Constraints

Axiom01 is a minimal, semantic-first CSS framework designed around native HTML elements and CSS custom properties.

### 1.1 Class Density Formulation

Every interface built with Axiom01 must strictly adhere to the Class Density constraint:

    Dc = (Total Class Attributes) / (Total Rendered Elements) <= 1.0

- Chaining utility classes on a single node is strictly prohibited.
- Prefer styling elements via native tag cascade, tag hierarchy, and semantic attributes over classes.
- Target class density for ideal layouts is `Dc < 0.5`.

### 1.2 Anti-Patterns

- Do not emit utility chains (for example, `class="flex flex-col p-4 bg-white rounded shadow"`).
- Do not wrap elements in arbitrary semantic-free containers (for example, `div.card-body` or `div.wrapper`).
- Do not use inline style declarations for layout rhythm, spacing, or color overrides.

## 2. Design Token Registry

All tokens utilize the prefix: `--a-`.

### 2.1 Spacing & Rhythm (4px Base Multiplier)

- `--a-space-unit`: `0.25rem` (4px base)
- `--a-space-2xs`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 0.5)` (2px)
- `--a-space-xs`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 1)` (4px)
- `--a-space-sm`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 2)` (8px)
- `--a-space-md`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 4)` (16px)
- `--a-space-lg`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 6)` (24px)
- `--a-space-xl`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 8)` (32px)
- `--a-space-2xl`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 12)` (48px)
- `--a-space-3xl`: `calc(var(--a-space-unit) * 16)` (64px)

### 2.2 Typography

- `--a-font-sans`: `system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif`
- `--a-font-mono`: `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace`
- `--a-text-xs`: `0.75rem` (12px)
- `--a-text-sm`: `0.875rem` (14px)
- `--a-text-base`: `1rem` (16px)
- `--a-text-md`: `1.125rem` (18px)
- `--a-text-lg`: `1.25rem` (20px)
- `--a-text-xl`: `1.5rem` (24px)
- `--a-text-2xl`: `2rem` (32px)
- `--a-text-3xl`: `2.5rem` (40px)
- `--a-line-tight`: `1.25`
- `--a-line-base`: `1.5`
- `--a-line-loose`: `1.75`

### 2.3 Color Tokens

- `--a-color-bg`: Root surface / canvas background
- `--a-color-surface`: Base container elevation
- `--a-color-surface-raised`: Modal, popover, and floating element background
- `--a-color-text`: High-contrast primary copy
- `--a-color-text-muted`: Secondary metadata copy
- `--a-color-border`: Outer boundary lines
- `--a-color-border-subtle`: Interior dividers
- `--a-color-primary`: Primary action indicator
- `--a-color-primary-hover`: State accent
- `--a-color-danger`: Destructive actions and alerts
- `--a-color-warning`: Advisory states
- `--a-color-success`: Confirmation states

### 2.4 Geometry & Animation

- `--a-radius-xs`: `2px`
- `--a-radius-sm`: `4px`
- `--a-radius-md`: `6px`
- `--a-radius-lg`: `12px`
- `--a-radius-full`: `9999px`
- `--a-transition-fast`: `120ms ease`
- `--a-transition-base`: `200ms ease`

## 3. Canonical HTML Markup Patterns

### 3.1 Card / Surface

```html
<article class="card">
  <header>
    <h3>Pipeline Status</h3>
    <small>Deterministic check: OK</small>
  </header>
  <p>Standard paragraph content cascades margin automatically from base styles.</p>
  <footer>
    <button type="button">Dismiss</button>
    <button class="primary" type="submit">Deploy</button>
  </footer>
</article>
```

### 3.2 Forms & Validation

```html
<form>
  <fieldset>
    <legend>Network Parameters</legend>

    <label for="endpoint">Endpoint URL</label>
    <input id="endpoint" name="endpoint" type="url" placeholder="https://api.domain.internal" required>

    <label for="protocol">Protocol Mode</label>
    <select id="protocol" name="protocol">
      <option value="grpc">gRPC</option>
      <option value="rest">REST</option>
    </select>

    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" name="tls" checked>
      Require Mutual TLS
    </label>
  </fieldset>

  <footer>
    <button class="primary" type="submit">Save Settings</button>
  </footer>
</form>
```

### 3.3 Navigation Header

```html
<nav>
  <a href="/" class="brand"><strong>Axiom01</strong></a>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/docs">Docs</a></li>
    <li><a href="/specs">Specs</a></li>
    <li><a href="/components">Components</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

### 3.4 Interactive Native Dialog / Modal

```html
<dialog id="modal-confirm" class="modal">
  <article>
    <header>
      <h3>Purge Verification</h3>
    </header>
    <p>This action will invalidate all downstream cache layers immediately.</p>
    <footer>
      <form method="dialog">
        <button type="submit" value="cancel">Cancel</button>
        <button class="danger" type="submit" value="confirm">Confirm</button>
      </form>
    </footer>
  </article>
</dialog>
```

### 3.5 Interactive Native Collapsible / Accordion

```html
<details>
  <summary>Runtime Parameters</summary>
  <p>Allocated memory: 256MB. Execution model: Event-driven worker pool.</p>
</details>
```

### 3.6 Data Table

```html
<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">Node</th>
      <th scope="col">Region</th>
      <th scope="col">Status</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>node-01</td>
      <td>us-west-1</td>
      <td>Healthy</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

### 3.7 Layout Grids

```html
<section class="grid-2">
  <article class="card">
    <p>Column 1</p>
  </article>
  <article class="card">
    <p>Column 2</p>
  </article>
</section>
```
